text: Computative Economics does not assert abundance simpliciter: it asserts abundance in the realization-level supply of generative outputs while retaining scarcity in computational capacity, domain expertise, and governance capacity, and it applies only to specific domains.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Computative Economics A Framework for Economic Analysis under Computational Abundance (2026). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=6607458
